# Hook exposure

<!-- GENERATED by `cargo run -p xtask -- lua-hooks`; do not edit. `--check` fails when this file is not what the classifier says. -->

Every native hook lands in exactly one class: `generated` (a zero-hand-work event table under the native name), `adapter` (a hand-written converter would unblock it), `handle` or `protocol` (a live handle or raw packets, each needing its own design), `tick` (the level-tick host the Lua runtime does not implement), or `cannot` (no event-table mapping exists, with the reason). `HOOK_CLASSIFICATION` in `crates/event-horizon-lua/src/generated_hooks/mod.rs` is the machine-readable record; this page is its human-readable form, so a hook is never silently missing from Lua: it is either generated or listed here with its reason.

388 hooks are generated and omitted below. The rest:
